# Notified for general information that the Five Year Interest-free Prize Bonds, 1965.

MINISTRY OF FINANCE (Department of Economic Affairs) NOTIFICATION New Delhi, the 3rd December 1960 No. 4(58)-W&M/60.—In pursuance of paragraph 7 of the Notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Finance (Department of Economic Affairs) No. 4(l)-W&M/60, dated the 1st March 1960, it is hereby notified for general information that the Five Year Interest-free Prize Bonds, 1965 shown in Schedules A and B appended hereto have won the prizes indicated against them at the second quarterly draw for prizes held on the 1st December, 1980.

SHIV NAUBH SINGH, Jt. Secy.

( 1097 ) L^ *• GOVERNMENT OF INDIA FIVE YEAR INTEREST FREE PRIZE BONDS, 1965 RESULTS OP THE SECOND QUARTERLY DRAW HELD ON 1ST DECEMBER, 1960.
